best_idea: A minimap list that gives, for each named place in the zone, its nearest-first distance and one of eight compass sectors from the player, with the current place found by a first-match rectangle test.
decision_why: Take the rectangle places, the first-match lookup and the nearest-first compass list as a HUD minimap; fix the north and south sign (screen y points down) and the pixel label; reject the AI prompt use because Frankendom has no text map for an AI.
acceptance: At 375 px wide the minimap lists every room nearest first with a compass letter and a pixel distance; standing in the Office shows Office as the current room; a unit test asserts a place above the player on the map gets N.
